title: Mg1 & Brownsville Mobsters - The Sun Never Shines

lines.l: I take a stroll around the block with the Glock
Ready to go to war, sights in the mind, it's just another duty talk
Nothing's ever changed, I never found it strange
How you could go from rags to riches, to back to begging for change
Life for the streets is a statistic, nothing to lose, so I risk it
I keep my finger on a biscuit, looking to pass it, maybe I'll last it
If I have to put some daisies on some mama's baby's casket
Cut shots, kill shots, every day I'll never rend it
Ain't no sense in me, my people's all pretending that we're all
One day going and working out, some will live, some will die
And others will roll a cloud, holding forth, like I'm pippin'
It's slipping, every time I hit the streets
Recognize game when it's coming
Everybody's got to eat today's course
Calls for precision and inner vision
The sky's still grey
In the block where I live
Along the walls of the battalists, expelling lyrics, preordained like a catalyst
Walk with death as the numbers slowly rise
Say blank if these dead or all chance of hopeless die
Negative is insidious as it strips you of your soul
The madness of the moment as it totally takes control
Squeezing off like a madman every chance that you get
Eight to eighty, if he's mad he's a threat
That's the mental and the mindset of the street
Breaking it back to the base, staying awake on your feet
Is the object of the game, there can be no opposition
Be wary of your step, cause you two can turn to miss it
In action, the next man is back and your reaction when the bullet hits the spot
Down goes another but the rain never stops
Meanwhile the sun never shines on my block
I paint a picture of a horizon that's always bleak
Ready to set the funk, get the asphalt like your feet
Got you shook cause you can't stand the pressure
Across on my mirror with two knives on my dresser
The sun don't shine cause hell ain't got no sky
You best to make your bones cause you'll get your chance to die
And that's a fact that can't be disputed
Like staring down the power waiting for someone to shoot it
To the curb with the burbs and the wingtip beats
Give it back to the masses, bring it back to the streets
Representing from the 516 and the crook
Opposition to the sparkle in your life
Gets took in a dash, it's a mad dash for the cash
That never seems to last, where's the beauty when you suffer?
While I half stand back and laugh, and the days get rougher
And rougher, and rougher
You know a hard look man, work on them key on my shirt
Can't get for see the doctor, now for see the nurse
Man out the streets, all I get lost hurt
Cause the rich, I'm getting richer, and the poor, I'm getting hurt
That's why you know I deserve, ain't no people dead
Nobody couple, I know why you did it
I know children want greed, but they're real-time dreads
We'll be here
